command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$HOME/.cache/omega777-current-main-converge
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/.git" ]; then git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$ROOT"; fi
cd "$ROOT"
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  git fetch -q origin main
  H1=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')
  echo ATTEMPT=$attempt HEAD_BEFORE=$H1
  git checkout -q --detach "$H1"
  test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$H1"
  git diff --check
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_organ_activity.py tests/test_omega_arm_bus.py tests/test_voice777_local_audio_arm.py tests/test_voice777_multiarm_integration.py tests/test_voice777_omni_presence.py tests/test_voice777_pocket_renderer.py tests/test_voice777_installer_convergence.py tests/test_voice777_cancel_loopback_probe.py
  H2=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')
  echo HEAD_AFTER_TESTS=$H2
  if [ "$H2" != "$H1" ]; then echo DRIFT_BEFORE_INSTALL=1; continue; fi
  VP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value)
  CP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value)
  echo PRE_PIDS=$VP:$CP
  bash scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh
  VP2=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value)
  CP2=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value)
  echo POST_PIDS=$VP2:$CP2
  test "$VP" = "$VP2"
  test "$CP" = "$CP2"
  for f in omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do cmp -s "scripts/$f" "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/$f" || { echo MISMATCH=$f; exit 31; }; done
  H3=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')
  echo HEAD_AFTER_INSTALL=$H3
  if [ "$H3" = "$H1" ]; then echo CONVERGED_HEAD=$H1; echo OMEGA_CURRENT_MAIN_SOURCE_INSTALL_PASS=1; exit 0; fi
  echo DRIFT_AFTER_INSTALL=1
done
echo OMEGA_CURRENT_MAIN_CONVERGENCE_UNSTABLE=1 >&2
exit 44
